title: Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha, 13 Mar 1992, Q69 (Maniram Siyag): electrification of MFFR displaced villages
what_it_contains: Answer (Energy): per Colonisation Commissioner Bikaner, MFFR displaced were settled in colonisation tehsils Pugal and Chhatargarh; list sent had 282 villages where displaced were settled, of which only 72 were census villages; 66 of these electrified, 6 pending.
why_relevant: New detail from a known record: the displaced were spread over ~282 chaks/abadis, not a few villages. Sets the scale for the map.

title: Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha, 24 Mar 1995, USQ 16: roads to new abadis of MFFR displaced
what_it_contains: PWD answer names new abadis Ramnagar, Krishna Nagar, Samarda and Chak 34 KYD; Samarda and 34 KYD are panchayat HQs; Krishi Upaj Mandi Bikaner sanctioned bitumen road to 34 KYD; Samarda (1971 pop 105) to get gravel road by end of 8th Plan.
why_relevant: Adds Samarda and 34 KYD as government-named resettlement abadis; Samarda = GP "Nosera Samrda" in LGD.

title: Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha, 25 Mar 1992: Takhtpura, Kharbara, Krishna Nagar, Ramnagar 80-90 km from Lunkaransar across the range
what_it_contains: Member says villages like Takhtpura, Kharbara, Krishna Nagar, Ramnagar lie 80-90 km from Lunkaransar with the range in between; people need two days to deposit bills.
why_relevant: Confirms Takhtpura and Kharbara in the resettlement belt and the distance problem.

title: Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha, 26 Mar 2007, starred Q31: MFFR allotment status

why_relevant: Annexure kha/ga = official list of resettlement abadis; needed offline.

title: DCH Bikaner 1981 Part XIII-A&B: village PCA rows (literacy by sex, SC) for 30 range villages and 6 destination villages, re-read from OCR
what_it_contains: 1981 crude literacy of 27 readable range villages: male 18.1%, female 1.7% (1,498/8,276 and 129/7,600); Lunkaransar tehsil 21.8%/4.6%. Kharbara, Takhtpura, Lakhansar, Raner with Damolai and Sansardesar were already small Lunkaransar-tehsil villages in 1981 (901, 343, 257, 1,025, 374 persons).
why_relevant: Gives the "then" side of per-village then-and-now cards; shows resettlement villages were existing hamlets across the range that grew with IGNP. Round 1 extracted only persons/households.
